say:1:1034137001:0.text: The Vaduso Mountains have been chaotic lately. For your own sake, you'd better head back.
say:1:1034137001:0.source_cn: 近来，瓦度索山脉可不安宁，为了你的小命着想，你还是回去吧。
say:1:1034137001:0.male: The Vaduso Mountains have been chaotic lately. For your own sake, you'd better head back.
say:1:1034137001:0.female: The Vaduso Mountains have been chaotic lately. For your own sake, you'd better head back.

say:2:1034137002:0.text: There are many hornleaf bears in the forest, and they've been particularly violent these past few days, attacking quite a few travelers.
say:2:1034137002:0.source_cn: 森林里居住着不少叶角熊，这两天它们格外暴躁，攻击了不少...

say:2:1034137002:0.female: There are many hornleaf bears in the forest, and they've been particularly violent these past few days, attacking quite a few travelers.

say:3:1034137003:0.text: For everyone's safety, Granny Fennel asked me to guard this place. If you have to go into the mountains, please take another path.
